light_description: Build-it-yourself dirt platform covering DOD 250 and MXR Distortion+ style gain ranges with selectable clipping options.
DIY fuzz project for builders seeking a classic saturated, sustain-heavy fuzz character.
Analog fuzz and filter hybrid that ranges from gritty drive to massive fuzz, with resonant filtering and gated textures.
Aggressive analog dirt processor combining saturated fuzz with pronounced filtering and synth-like harmonic textures.
Silicon fuzz designed for dynamic response, ranging from clean boost and overdrive through saturated fuzz with pronounced low mids.
Discrete-transistor medium-gain overdrive emphasizing dynamic range, note clarity and harmonic fullness, with a response that can become fuzzy at higher settings.
Compact overdrive designed for articulate medium-gain drive with adjustable low-frequency response and a focused, amplifier-like character.
FET-based amplifier-style overdrive and preamp with a broad clean-to-driven range and strong touch sensitivity.

Compact high-headroom boost that can add clean level or push an amplifier into overdrive.

Highly adjustable fuzz/distortion platform with extensive filtering and clipping control for thick, modern and experimental gain textures.
Tight high-gain distortion with deep EQ shaping and a forceful response aimed at aggressive modern guitar tones.

Low-to-medium gain overdrive built around a smooth, singing response with adjustable gain, tone, voice and output characteristics.
Amplifier-style overdrive designed to provide open, dynamic breakup with useful response from low gain through stronger drive.
Responsive overdrive with a wide gain range, allowing clean boost, light breakup and thicker saturated drive.
Simple one-knob gain stage that adds volume and increasingly gritty amplifier-like breakup as it is turned up.
Modern fuzz with a thick, saturated voice and strong harmonic character, surfaced in the September 2026 Effects Database new-brand index.
Flexible distortion with selectable clipping that ranges from open crunch to hard, saturated distortion and fuzz-like textures.
Harmonic Percolator interpretation using germanium and silicon clipping options to move between rough overdrive and fuzz.
